title: DS6a_5EU_Pulse_RawData (Schmidt, Rohatgi, Brandman 2022)
attribution: Images: Schmidt HB, Rohatgi R, Brandman O (2022), DS6a_5EU_Pulse_RawData, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6643470, CC BY 4.0; centre-cropped, channel subset.
citation: Schmidt HB et al. Oxaliplatin disrupts nucleolar function through biophysical disintegration. Cell Reports 2022. doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2022.111629
description: U2OS cells with endogenous FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP knock-ins; Hoechst nuclear stain. Olympus IX83 widefield, 40x/1.4 oil, 0.1625 um/px, single plane, uint16 OME-TIFF.
modifications: Centre 1536 x 1536 crop of each 2304 x 2304 plane; channels Hoechst (OME c3, filter DAPI) and NPM1-mTagRFP (OME c1, filter TRITC) only; pixel values unchanged; re-saved as uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: All replicates (Rep1-Rep3) were acquired on the same date (2021-12-01). The source does not state whether Rep1-Rep3 are independent experiments; they are treated as replicate units for demonstration only.

Each replicate contains both conditions; the demo pairs conditions by replicate (paired t-test over three pairs, one field per condition and replicate). With three pairs the test has very low power; p-values are illustrations of the workflow, not findings.

Nucleoli are defined from NPM1 with the workspace's nucleolar-marker definition (default parameters). Under ActD, NPM1 partly relocates to the nucleoplasm, so marker-defined nucleoli reflect NPM1 distribution, not nucleolar structure alone.
Hoechst saturates (value 65535) in a small fraction of pixels in some fields; counts are listed in manifest.json (selection.results[].saturated_pixels).
Demonstration numbers from public images; they do not establish scientific validity for any laboratory's images.
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

Before the nucleolar analysis, the demo's researcher review deleted small objects that StarDist segmented as nuclei but that are fragments (smaller than 0.6 x the field's median nuclear area) and in which no nucleolus could be established; the deleted objects are listed in manifest.json (fragment_review).
